tests: How read replicas differ from Multi-AZ under a read-heavy workload with high CPU on the primary.
expected: Add RDS read replicas and route reads to them — this offloads the primary. Triggers: "read-heavy", "high CPU on primary", "improve read performance".
why_not: Multi-AZ — for failover, the standby doesn't serve reads; backup retention and more storage don't affect read CPU.
